steps.js: (() => { const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.search-panel button.search-panel__row')]; const row=rows.find(e=>e.textContent.includes('e2e-test-project')); if(!row) return 'row-not-found'; window.__ev=[]; for(const t of ['mousedown','mouseup','click']) row.addEventListener(t, ()=>window.__ev.push(t), {once:false, capture:true}); const r=row.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({rect:{x:Math.round(r.x),y:Math.round(r.y),w:Math.round(r.width),h:Math.round(r.height)}, center:{x:Math.round(r.x+r.width/2),y:Math.round(r.y+r.height/2)}}); })()
steps.desc: 在弹窗项目行挂事件监听并记录坐标
读事件触发记录与展开状态
